name: MICAS Malta International Contemporary Art Space
funding: A EUR 30M project funded by the Maltese state and the European Regional Development Fund; the gallery works were co-financed 80% EU, 20% national.
watch: A EUR 0.5M Rondinone sculpture was bought with no public call via board member Francis Sultana, who sells Rondinone. The minister denies a conflict.
why_flagged: A EUR 0.5M Rondinone sculpture was bought with no public call via board member Francis Sultana, who sells Rondinone. The minister denies a conflict.
records_note: Names four board members and an international committee on its about page; publishes no annual report, accounts or sponsor list.

name: Migros Museum
funding: Institution of the Migros-Kulturprozent, carried by the Migros cooperative federation, which pays a turnover-based sum into culture since 1957. The sheet lists CHF 12 tickets and no public funder.
watch: It follows the model set by Migros cooperative founder Gottlieb Duttweiler, which mandates 1% of cooperative wholesale turnover for culture and education.
why_flagged: Migros owns fuel supplier Migrol: CHF 1.3bn of CHF 31.9bn group sales in 2025, about 4%. Fuel is not its main line.
records_note: The museum publishes nothing itself; parent Migros-Genossenschafts-Bund publishes reports 2020 to 2025, audited accounts and its board. No donor list.

name: Milwaukee Symphony Orchestra
watch: Peter Mahler sat on the Milwaukee Symphony Orchestra's 35-member board until February 2026. FOX6 first reported his Epstein link on 9 February 2026.
why_flagged: FY2025 revenue $19.8M. 2024-25 report: United Performing Arts Fund $1M+; Bradley, Argosy and Laskin foundations $250,000+; We Energies Foundation, Rockwell Automation and Herzfeld Foundation $100,000+.
records_note: It posts its 2024-25 annual report with a named donor list, audited statements for 2025, a 2024 Form 990, and 31 named directors.

name: Misk Art Institute
funding: Subsidiary of the Mohammed bin Salman Foundation (Misk), a non-profit the Crown Prince founded in 2011. No budget or donor list found on its site.
watch: Founded December 2017; Ahmed Mater was its director then. Its summer 2026 show at Prince Faisal bin Fahd Arts Hall has over 40 works.
why_flagged: Subsidiary of the Mohammed bin Salman Foundation (Misk), a non-profit the Crown Prince founded in 2011. No budget or donor list found on its site.
records_note: The Institute posts no reports or board; its parent Misk Foundation lists annual reports for 2019 to 2024, and no accounts or donors are published.

name: MIT Media Lab
watch: MIT's Goodwin Procter review (January 2020) found Epstein gave MIT $850,000 in 10 gifts from 2002 to 2017, nine of them after his 2008 conviction, including $525,000 to the Media Lab under director Joi Ito. The New Yorker reported that Epstein arranged at least $7.5 million in donations to the Lab and that the Lab logged his gifts as anonymous, while MIT's donor database marked him "disqualified".
why_flagged: Funded by member companies. Fourteen joined in 2024, including Sony, HP, Kenvue, Kohler and MITRE.
records_note: The Lab posts annual reports from 2004 to 2025; parent MIT's Form 990s and audits are public, and the MIT Corporation is listed by name.

name: MK Gallery
watch: Still credits the Sackler Trust as a capital donor.
why_flagged: Still credits the Sackler Trust as a capital donor.
records_note: It files group accounts at Companies House for 2023 to 2025, names supporters by tier undated, and lists 15 board members, but posts no reports.

name: MOCA Cleveland
watch: Bloomberg Philanthropies gives lead institutional support. In 2020 the museum cancelled Shaun Leonardo's show; it later apologised and the director resigned.
why_flagged: Bloomberg Philanthropies gives lead institutional support. In 2020 the museum cancelled Shaun Leonardo's show; it later apologised and the director resigned.
records_note: Its Form 990 is public for 2001 to 2025, it names institutional supporters undated and lists its board; no annual reports found.

name: MOCA Tucson
watch: The casino donor is the Tohono O'odham Nation's tribal gaming enterprise, at the $5,000+ level. No protest found.
why_flagged: The casino donor is the Tohono O'odham Nation's tribal gaming enterprise, at the $5,000+ level. No protest found.
records_note: It posts a 2024 annual report naming its grant funders and gala sponsors, plus a named board; Form 990s are on ProPublica.

name: MoMA (The Museum of Modern Art)
funding: Admissions, individual board donations, Bloomberg Philanthropies, Hyundai Card, UNIQLO (UNIQLO NYC Nights), Cartier, Bank of America, Chanel, Volkswagen Group, Allianz.
watch: Leon Black still a trustee after Epstein payments; Fink, Crown and Dubin named in Strike MoMA and the 2024 sit-in.
why_flagged: Leon Black still a trustee after Epstein payments; Fink, Crown and Dubin named in Strike MoMA and the 2024 sit-in.
records_note: Its Year in Review reports run from 2014 to 2025, with audited statements and Form 990 posted; the donor list seen is dated 2016.

name: MUAC
records_note: MUAC has no records of its own; parent UNAM publishes audited 2025 accounts and lists its Junta de Gobierno; MUAC's benefactors page names donors undated.

name: Multimedia Art Museum, Moscow (MAMM)
watch: Alfa-Bank is on the US (Apr 2022), UK (Mar 2022) and EU (Feb 2023) sanctions lists. Nornickel itself is not blocked.
why_flagged: Founded by the Moscow Government in 1996, director Olga Sviblova. Partners page lists Nornickel as corporate trustee, Alfa-Bank as strategic partner, plus Live Sound and Priorov Center.
records_note: The museum posts 2025 results and financial reports and plans, names Nornickel and Alfa-Bank as partners without a date, and lists no board.

name: MUNCH
records_note: The museum posts a 2024 annual report, shows seven sponsor logos with no date, and names no board; it is a unit of Oslo municipality.
